$description: Customer Design-DNA modes for the AI Website & Business Builder. W3C Design Tokens Community Group format, matching /workspace/rsd-light/tokens.json. Contains ONLY semantic-token overrides for three example customer modes. Do not edit Light Experience primitives or component tokens here. Component tokens continue to resolve through semantic aliases. On the Figma Starter plan a collection has only 1 mode; these DNA modes are represented in Figma as parallel collections (or literal values). From the Professional plan they become real modes on the semantic collection, alongside light-cream (default), pure-white-silver and warm-graphite. WCAG 2.2 AA is a hard floor for every intended text/surface pair including micro/caption (≥ 4.5:1) and for borders/UI (≥ 3:1). Example content only.

com.rsd.meta.dna_contract: Override ONLY semantic tokens via extra modes. Do not change primitives or the Light Experience file. Component tokens resolve through semantic aliases.
com.rsd.meta.figma_starter_plan: 1 mode per collection, 3 pages max. DNA modes are parallel collections until Professional.

axes_not_in_semantic_109.comment: Varianten-Achsen sind Teil der DNA, aber keine der 111 semantischen Light-Experience-Tokens. Nicht in diese Override-Liste aufgenommen. Schlüssel axes_not_in_semantic_109 bleibt als Alias.

unmapped_dna_dimensions.Bildsprache: Kein semantischer Token in den 111 Namen; bleibt DNA-Preset (Foto/Illustration, Beschnitt, Behandlung).
unmapped_dna_dimensions.Tonalität: Kein semantischer Token in den 111 Namen; steuert Copy, nicht das Token-File.
unmapped_dna_dimensions.type/family/display: Nicht in den 111 Namen. Headlines in den Figma-Beispielen nutzen Source Serif 4 / Space Grotesk / Newsreader auf Komponentenebene, bis Light Experience ggf. type/family/display ergänzt. type/family/sans wird pro DNA überschrieben.

wcag.generator_rule: Remix and distance adjustment must never go below AA. If uniqueness is only reachable via contrast loss, adjust other dimensions or block.
wcag.corrected: 2026-11-13 — overlay colors raised to AA; do not change Light Experience files.
